title: Big Bang and the origin of the universe
summary: The universe is about 13.8 billion years old. NASA's WMAP mission put its age at 13.77 billion years and ESA's Planck mission at 13.82 billion. The cosmic microwave background that both mapped is the relic radiation from the Big Bang. NASA's timeline of the universe begins at the earliest moment scientists can now probe, a burst of exponential growth called inflation.

uncertainty.note: Estimated between 13.77 billion years (NASA WMAP) and 13.82 billion years (ESA Planck space mission).

as_recorded.value: Determined the universe to be 13.77 billion years old to within a half percent
The data imply that the age of the Universe is 13.82 billion years

importance.justification: The Big Bang marks the origin of the universe, space, time, and matter, foundational to all cosmic, geological, and biological history.

related.because: Observations of the cosmic microwave background at Holmdel confirmed the Big Bang model of cosmic expansion.
The matter and elements generated by the Big Bang and subsequent stellar generations formed the solar nebula and planetary systems.
